subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: After real Microsoft Teams delivery proof is supplied, should this branch become the canonical fix instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867?
rationale: Both branches implement the same production hook, neither currently has sufficient real Teams delivery proof, and only maintainers should select which contributor branch or replacement owns the final landing path.

options.title: Prove and use this branch
options.body: Require redacted live Gateway-to-Teams or Bot Framework proof on this branch, then use its stronger shared-pipeline regression coverage as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Prefer the older branch
options.body: Require equivalent real proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 and use its narrower patch if maintainers prefer that branch.

options.title: Create a maintainer replacement
options.body: Pause both contributor branches and land a focused maintainer-owned replacement with transport proof and contributor credit.

recommendation.title: Prove and use this branch
recommendation.body: Require redacted live Gateway-to-Teams or Bot Framework proof on this branch, then use its stronger shared-pipeline regression coverage as the canonical implementation.
